calculation.description: Contrarian five-day asset return, with signal magnitude amplified when the observation-only DXY has experienced a large five-day absolute move. The signal is computed at date t and evaluated against forward returns after t, avoiding future data.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the available synthetic cross-asset history and 15 tradable instruments; at least 8 instruments were required per daily cross-section. Uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the universe is small. Strongest result is one-day and decays over longer horizons.
